region.name: Karavali (Coastal Karnataka)
region.subtitle: Arabian Sea Shoreline, Estuaries, and Tuluva-Konkani Heritage

districts.name: Dakshina Kannada
districts.description: Vibrant Tuluva culture, bustling coastal ports, ancient temples, traditional Yakshagana theatre, and rich maritime heritage.

districts.name: Udupi
districts.description: Sacred temple towns, volcanic basalt pillar islands, lighthouses, world-renowned culinary tradition (Udupi cuisine), and pristine beaches.

districts.name: Uttara Kannada
districts.description: Forested Western Ghat hills, historical sea forts, pristine estuaries, revered pilgrim centers like Gokarna, and ancient cave formations.

geography.boundaries: Arabian Sea to the West, Western Ghats (Sahyadri) to the East

cultural_highlights: Pili Vesha (Tiger Dance during Dasara/Krishna Janmashtami)
Kambala (Traditional Buffalo Race in Paddy Fields)
